name: Chain-of-Experts
org: Zhejiang University, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab
one_liner: Multi-agent operations-research pipeline that translates natural-language optimization problems into LP/MIP code and repairs from program execution feedback.

loop.proposes: Specialized LLM roles extract mathematical terminology, formulate algebraic constraints, and emit Python PuLP/Gurobi solver code.
loop.judged_by: The Python interpreter and MIP solver execute the generated formulation and report syntax errors, infeasibility, or optimal objective values.
loop.steers: A conductor chooses which role acts next; on a failed run the roles reflect on execution feedback in reverse order until one is at fault.

headline_result: Reported to significantly outperform state-of-the-art LLM-based approaches on the LPWP and ComplexOR operations research benchmarks.
caveat: If the formulation specialist misinterprets an implicit constraint in the word problem without causing solver infeasibility, the MIP solver solves the wrong model.
beyond_harness_note: An exact linear/integer programming solver computes the solution while program execution feedback drives reverse-order reflection by the roles.

sources.title: Chain-of-Experts: When LLMs Meet Complex Operations Research Problems (ICLR 2024 poster)

verification.notes: Re-checked against Xiao et al., ICLR 2024 poster page (OpenReview HobyL1B9CZ); no arXiv id exists.
